verdict.rationale: GitHub documents two first-party programmatic surfaces, a REST API and a GraphQL API, for creating integrations, retrieving data and automating workflows. Fine-grained token permissions map to endpoints, and the official GitHub CLI and MCP server extend repo, issue, PR and Actions operations to programmatic users. However, the evidence never claims or shows that every UI capability is reachable via the API. missing for 10: an explicit documented API/UI parity guarantee or coverage map, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the docs-path probes returned 404), and independent hands-on confirmation that UI-only features such as Copilot agent sessions, settings and project management are fully API-accessible.
